sentence: This project studies how nerves in the airways are regulated, since these nerves help cause sneezing, coughing and wheezing in allergic inflammation.
This project looks for genetic markers that can predict who is at risk for serious side effects from cancer immunotherapies.
This project builds a human intestinal organoid tool from stem cells that tests drugs for toxicity and fibrosis.
This project studies how tau damage in brain networks relates to psychotic symptoms in Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies the genetic causes of urinary stone disease using sequencing technology and builds a risk model.
This project develops better ways to deliver larger dystrophins and to edit genes in stem cells for gene therapy.
This project builds a telehealth platform that helps hair stylists spot skin concerns early and refer clients to dermatologists.
This project studies how the brain controls the drive to avoid alcohol withdrawal, to find ways to prevent relapse.
This project develops gene editing methods that make blood cells resistant to immunotherapies used against acute myeloid leukemia.
This project studies how RNA-targeting CRISPR systems defend cells by cutting RNA and how they acquire immunity.
This project studies how cells fuse into giant cells after a wound, how they help repair it and how they are removed.
This project studies how alcohol triggers immune responses in brain cells and synapses that may contribute to excessive drinking.
This project studies how structural factors and exposures across life affect the risk of cardiovascular disease.
This project builds mouse models of severe alpha-thalassemia and tests if a lentiviral vector with the human alpha-globin gene can correct it.
This project tries to find signaling molecules that guide development in plant roots and how cells sense them to make decisions.
This project offers imaging scanners, including MRI and ultrasound, for preclinical cancer research.
This project designs and tests improved gene therapies for Duchenne and Limb Girdle Muscular Dystrophy and follows patients who received them.
This project tests whether DNA methylation in blood can predict outcomes for people with head and neck cancer.
This project studies how a set of proteins shapes the size and strength of coronary plaques and tests a drug in a large animal model.
This project studies how mutated blood cells damage the bone marrow and cause scar tissue in myelofibrosis.
